theorem_title: Logarithmic rate of the hierarchy envelope
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.HierarchyScales.hierarchyEnvelope_log_rate (C B : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.HierarchyScales.hierarchyEnvelope C B n) / Real.log n) atTop (𝓝 (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Parameters.epsilon*C)) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For any real constants $C,B$, $$\frac{\log(\operatorname{hierarchyEnvelope}(C,B,n))}{\log n}\longrightarrow\varepsilon C\quad(n\to\infty).$$ Here $\varepsilon$ is the fixed scale parameter.

This limit converts a hierarchy envelope into the polynomial exponent used by the final uniform runtime bound.
